name: pattern-parts
description: A pattern or a short command taken apart: each piece in large mono type with a coloured underline and a short label saying what it means, plus an optional plain-English reading underneath.

label.description: what it means, a few words

tone.description: wild: a piece that stands for other text; exact: literal text; how: an instruction (a command letter, an option); plain: punctuation with no label

gloss.description: markdown-lite: the whole thing read as plain English
